title: v2.1.317
excerpt: What's changed Added a warning to /schedule when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network Added onFailure: "block" for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view Added anthropic.plan , anthropic.seat_type , anthropic.provider and anthropic.custom_base_url to OTel metrics, events and spans Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost , for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group Added a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with admin: set, kept for admin.identity_retention_days , which the cost report groups by Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID : set it to 1 on a self-hosted runner to have claude -p run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions Fixed auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422
